ctx.x: I just knew him the last couple years before he died back about 1946 six and seven he thought a lot

of me and he respected me as giving him a lot of encouragement and a lot of licks you know from the drum standpoint because those younger fellas they had quite a respect for me at my age and my experience and I appreciate that out of them but getting back to Bill is Big Bill I mean Bill the bass player is he still living? Bill Johnson is down in Texas I haven't been
able to find him but they say he's in San Antonio I still hope to see him about 86 years old now or 87 maybe he was quite
